findings.claim: Group 3 leaves the last work card unreachable and tells the projection to emit a cursor its own grammar refuses. Declared: "for lane_start it is 0..19 (0 permits retrying work omitted for fit on the initial read)" (539-540) and "Offset must be below total; no cursor for empty lists." (544). Practiced elsewhere: "At most 22 source IDs per profile." (91) with repo required and retained optional permits 21 dispatch source IDs; "Work is authorized dispatch summaries only, ordered by configured job_ids" (260-261) plus "Missing work binding sets lineage null, relevance unknown and reason metadata-missing." (273-274) put every authorized dispatch ID in the work list, so total can be 21. The 0..19 range was derived from "work_bindings | 0..20 entries" (119), which bounds the binding table, not the list. With 21 authorized dispatch IDs and no bindings, a page sequence of 5,5,5,5 (plausible once 26 Source entries sit in the mandatory frame under the 8192 cap) reaches offset 20, and 588-590 then requires appending "work next cursor: SNAPSHOT:OFFSET" with OFFSET = offset+count = 20 — an out-of-range offset the cursor rule refuses (545), so the 21st card can never be fetched. D-A38b (786) pins only 20 bindings and does not cover this. Minimal correction: cap dispatch source IDs at 20 per profile (22 = repo + retained + 20), or state the lane_start offset range as 0..20 with the work-list bound named; keep tools at 11 and D-A38b's 8/8/4 unchanged.

The commit body claims "27 local links" checked. Measured: 33 markdown link occurrences across the three documents (14 + 2 + 17), of which 10 are https (all in conductor-start-plan.md), leaving 23 local occurrences over 20 unique targets. Every local target resolves and all three fragments resolve (conductor-start-plan.md#symfony-mapping-preserved-historical-measurement against the heading at plan:218; discovery-lever.md#non-executable-acceptance-rows; handoff/README.md#discovery-metadata-extension against the heading at README:26). The counting rule behind 27 is not declared and could not be reproduced. Minimal correction: restate the number or name the rule that produces it.
